hero.headline: Building the digital foundation for trusted local mobility.
hero.subheadline: We are creating a smarter and safer mobility platform focused on improving everyday local travel for both passengers and drivers.

story.title: Why Local Transport Needs a Safety Layer
paragraphs: Local transport is one of the most important parts of daily life, yet many rides still happen without any digital verification, accountability, or organized support system.

By combining QR-based ride verification, driver onboarding, ride records, and operational support systems, we aim to bridge that gap—making street-hailed travel safer without making it more complicated.
story.manifesto: Our goal is simple — create a trusted connection between passengers and drivers through technology that feels easy to use in real-world situations.

vision.statement: To build a trusted mobility ecosystem where local travel becomes safer, more transparent, and digitally connected.
vision.description: Every street-hailed auto ride digitally authenticated, offering riders confidence and drivers lasting credibility.

mission.statement: To simplify local mobility while creating systems that improve trust, organization, and ride transparency.
mission.description: Building practical tools that help passengers travel with confidence and empower drivers to grow within a verified digital network.

whatMakesUsDifferent.title: What Makes Us Different
whatMakesUsDifferent.subtitle: Purpose-built around the realities of everyday local commuting.

pillars.title: QR-Based Ride Verification
pillars.description: Instead of complicated booking flows or waiting screens, passengers quickly scan a QR code inside the auto to digitally connect their ride.

pillars.title: Focus on Safety and Accountability
pillars.description: Systems designed to create clear ride visibility, verified vehicle records, and responsive operational support workflows.

pillars.title: Built for Real Local Transport
pillars.description: Engineered for real-world local commuting—fast handshakes that work reliably even on fluctuating mobile networks.

pillars.title: Driver-Friendly Approach
pillars.description: We believe technology should support drivers, not complicate their work or reduce their daily earnings.

lookingAhead.title: Looking Ahead
lookingAhead.headline: This is just the beginning of a much larger vision for connected local mobility.
lookingAhead.description: We are continuously working on improving the platform with better safety features, smarter ride systems, and stronger operational support.

focusAreas.label: Smarter Ride Systems
focusAreas.desc: Faster verification handshakes and seamless digital receipts across every trip.

focusAreas.label: Enhanced Safety Tools
focusAreas.desc: Live trip sharing, family safety alerts, and rapid emergency response routing.

focusAreas.label: Stronger Driver Support
focusAreas.desc: Expanded onboarding hubs and welfare tools built for our verified driver community.
